CORP_USER, CUST_ID, BANK_ID, BRANCH_ID


--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT CORP_USER, CUST_ID, BANK_ID, BRANCH_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CORP_USER, CUST_ID, BANK_ID, BRANCH_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CORP_USER, CUST_ID, BANK_ID, BRANCH_ID ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC, FILE_NAME DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* INTO BUSC.BUSC.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION_WITH_DUP_20231005
FROM BUSC.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION; --Target table to remove duplicate

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM BUSC.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION

SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM BUSC.BUSC.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION_WITH_DUP_20231005


--5 UPDATE ISLATEST = 0
UPDATE BUSC.BUSC.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION_WITH_DUP_20231005 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1;

--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO BUSC.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
BANK_ID
,BAY_USER_ID
,BRANCH_ID
,CORP_USER
,CUST_BANK_ID
,CUST_ID
,CUSTOMER_TYPE
,DB_TS
,DEL_FLG
,GRP_ID
,R_CRE_ID
,R_CRE_TIME
,R_MOD_ID
,R_MOD_TIME
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
FROM BUSC.BUSC.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION_WITH_DUP_20231005; -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records


--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT CORP_USER, CUST_ID, BANK_ID, BRANCH_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CORP_USER, CUST_ID, BANK_ID, BRANCH_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--7
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.BUSC.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION_WITH_DUP_20231005
